pages.title: Cosmic Neutronium Ingot
pages.text: Neutronium compressed together with dark matter in the heart of a star. Starlight drifts through its interior, slowly, as though it were a tiny galaxy. It is the heaviest thing I own and gives off a faint, cold glow.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Breaking a Block of Cosmic Neutronium apart by hand, I found each ingot still held its own drifting starlight. It is the strongest material I have ever worked.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Pedestal, Biosphere Compendium, Block of Cosmic Neutronium, Cantor Diagonalizer, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Cosmic Neutronium Coil Block, Dimensional Residue, Hyperdimensional Pearl and more.
